role: senior app marketing lead: copy line by line, phrasing, voice, headlines, CTAs, scannability, the X-creator feel
verdict: The headline system, the X-native example voice ($tickers, lowercase, 'no hero trades') and the honest preview copy are close to best-in-class, and every heading lands in two lines. But every Start button opens a signup sheet whose honesty notice renders as a broken word-per-line column over the buttons (P0, so the score is capped at 8), and the demo's receipts repeat one explanation and sometimes overclaim on a visitor's own line.
to_95: Fix the signup sheet's 'Design preview: no account is created yet.' line. `.sh-pv span` also styles the text span as a 6px ring, so the text spills one word per line over the plan pills and Continue with X at every width.

Never certify a line Sharpen left alone. Drop 'It reads clean as it is.' and 'no safe move makes it stronger'. When nothing was cut, say 'Nothing Sharpen can cut safely.' and offer the rewrite. Also teach the engine 'I have to be honest with you guys', 'I wanted to talk a little bit about' and 'Let me tell you about'.

Vary the demo receipts. Four of the six built-in examples explain 'full stop / pause / second beat land' and the other two say 'number first / reads as proof'. Swap the Try default and the final card for lines that show other moves ('Said it straight', 'Asked, then answered', cutting an announcement). Stop the hero and final drafts both opening with 'just wanted to share/say that'.
Rewrite the 'Is it just AI writing?' answer so it doesn't open with 'No.' and then credit Claude twice. Lead with 'It edits, it doesn't invent.'
Make legal.html's 'What leaves, and when' match the homepage. In the app, Sharpen sends your line to Claude. Remove 'Quick mode' and 'your Hookworthy server'.
Give Pro one job: change its tagline to 'For posting every day.' and show '500 auto-sent posts a month' as a visible bullet on phones.

Stop the top result from mangling common X shapes: 'Hot take: Figma is…' becomes 'Overrated for early stage startups: figma.' Show the alternative when the primary lowercases a proper noun or turns a topic into a claim.
Trim the repeated copy: the pricing lede restates the H2, the final card's note restates the final sub, and the on-device/Claude explanation appears four times.

issues.area: Signup sheet (every Start free / Start with Pro / Start with Studio / Sign in / Schedule / Keep it)
issues.where: home.html CSS line 1045 `.sh-pv span{flex:none;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;…}` applied to both spans of #sh-pv
issues.problem: The honest-preview disclosure ('Design preview: no account is created yet.' / 'Design preview: sign-in isn’t live yet.') is crushed into a 6×6px ring. Its words overflow one per line down over the Free/Pro/Studio pills and the Continue with X / Google buttons, at 360, 390, 768 and 1440. This is the most important honesty line on the conversion screen, and the first tap on the hero's Start free shows a sheet that looks broken.
issues.fix: Scope the ring to the dot only: change the selector to `.sh-pv > span:first-child` (or give the dot a class, `<span class="dot" aria-hidden="true">`, and style `.sh-pv .dot`). Then let #sh-pv-t wrap normally (`flex:1;min-width:0`). Re-check at 360 that the line sits on one or two lines under the subtitle.

issues.area: Sharpen receipts on a visitor's own line (Try box and final card)
issues.where: core.js clean-state why strings, shown in #out-why / #fp-why and the 'Nothing to cut' label in #out-st
issues.problem: Some verdicts certify lines the page itself teaches are fluff. 'I have to be honest with you guys, I almost quit writing last month' gets 'Nothing soft to cut. It reads clean as it is.', while the page's own chip copy says 'Lines that land never announce their honesty.' 'I wanted to talk a little bit about why I quit my job at Google after 6 years' and 'Let me tell you about the worst trade of my life' get 'Nothing to cut'. 'Nothing soft to cut, and no safe move makes it stronger' is engine jargon. A visitor testing a typical opener reads this as either 'the tool missed it' or 'the tool is wrong', at the exact moment the page is asking for trust.
issues.fix: Copy: when state is clean and the line has 3+ words, use one honest verdict everywhere: label 'Nothing safe to cut', why 'Sharpen only cuts what it can cut without changing your meaning. Want it to lead harder? Get a rewrite in your voice, free'. Keep 'Short and complete.' for 1–2 word posts, and don't repeat 'Nothing to cut' in both the label and the why. Engine (owner: hook juror): add 'I have to be honest (with you guys),', 'I wanted to talk (a little bit) about', 'Let me tell you about' and 'A lot of people ask me' to the throat-clearing set.

issues.where: Hero EX[0] and EX[3] whys, Try default #out-why, final card #fp-why; hero EX[1] and EX[2] whys
issues.problem: Of six built-in receipts, four explain the same move ('The full stop before “…” is the pause that makes the second beat land' ×2, 'Two short beats with a full stop between them. The pause makes the second one land.' ×2). The other two share 'reads as proof before anyone (has) decided whether to keep reading'. The hero and final drafts both open with 'just wanted to share/say that'. Sharpen reads as a one-trick full-stop inserter, and 'Why it hits' starts to feel canned by the second screen.
issues.fix: Keep the hero Trader (two beats) and Founder (number first). Change the Try default to an opinion line whose receipt is 'Said it straight', e.g. 'i don’t think you should size up after a red day' → 'Don’t size up after a red day.' Change the final example to an announcement cut ('We’re so excited to share that our newsletter just hit 20,000 subscribers' → 'Our newsletter just hit 20,000 subscribers.') so the last receipt shows a different move. Alternatively, make the Newsletter hero example an 'Asked, then answered'. Use the engine's real output for each, as now.

issues.problem: The answer opens with 'No.' and then says Claude sharpens the line and Claude writes rewrites. An AI-skeptical creator reads that as a dodge. At five sentences it is also the longest answer, and it spends a sentence on engine architecture ('the on-device engine is the instant fallback; this page’s demo runs the on-device one'). This is the main objection for X writers who fear sounding like AI.
issues.fix: Replace with: 'It edits, it doesn’t invent. Sharpen (Claude in the app, an on-device engine on this page) only cuts, tightens and reorders your words, and a check throws out any version that adds a fact, a number or a name. Rewrites in your voice run only when you ask, with every changed word marked. Missing a number? It writes [your number] and waits.'

issues.area: legal.html privacy copy vs homepage claims
issues.problem: Legal says 'A rewrite with Claude sends that text to Claude; Quick mode stays on your device.' The homepage says that in the app Claude sharpens every line. So the privacy page undercounts what leaves, and 'Quick mode' is a name the homepage never uses. 'Goes through your Hookworthy server' (also in 'Clearing it') reads as if the visitor runs a server.
issues.fix: Rewrite as: 'Only what you ask for. In the app, Sharpen and rewrites send that line to Claude; the on-device engine, and the demo on our homepage, never leave your browser. A post you schedule goes to X or LinkedIn at the time you picked, once you connect them. Sync, if you turn it on, is encrypted on this device before it reaches Hookworthy’s servers.' In 'Clearing it', change 'your Hookworthy server' to 'Hookworthy’s servers'.

issues.where: Pro .for 'For catching the post that takes off.'; Pro bullets with class .mob at ≤760px; FAQ #qa5 'Posting every day? Pro is $12…'
issues.problem: Pro is sold three ways. The tagline sells the takes-off ping, the FAQ sells daily posting, and on phones the two visible Pro bullets ('A ping when a post takes off', '250 rewrites…') hide the concrete upgrade from Free's visible '15 auto-sent posts a month' to 500. The clearest reason to pay is invisible on the device most X creators will use.
issues.fix: Tagline: 'For posting every day.' Mark '500 posts a month auto-sent at your time' as .pk so it shows on phones (mob copy: '500 auto-sent posts a month'), and keep 'A ping when a post takes off' as the second visible bullet. Leave the FAQ line as is; it now agrees.

issues.area: Sharpen receipts: wrong primary outputs on common X shapes
issues.where: Try box / final card, top result for visitor lines (engine core.js)
issues.problem: 'Hot take: Figma is actually kind of overrated for early stage startups' returns 'Overrated for early stage startups: figma.' A brand is lowercased and the order is inverted, but it is shown under 'Why it hits: The payoff sits at the end of the line…', while the better 'Figma is overrated for early stage startups.' is hidden behind 'Another version'. 'So I've been thinking a lot about how founders talk about their failures' becomes the claim 'Founders talk about their failures.' 'We are thrilled to announce our Series A' becomes 'We raised a Series A.', which adds a verb the writer didn't say. Each one breaks the 'Your facts stay' headline on a line a visitor is likely to paste.
issues.fix: (Engine; flagged for the hook juror.) Rank the alternative first when the primary changes a capitalised word's case or moves the subject to the end. Don't turn 'thinking about how X' into the assertion 'X'; cut only 'So I've been thinking a lot about' and keep 'how founders talk about their failures' as the topic. For 'thrilled to announce our Series A', show 'Our Series A.' or leave the line for a rewrite rather than adding 'raised'.

issues.where: #out-k / #fp-k 'Why it hits'; put-back why; #out-st while typing
issues.problem: (a) 'Why it hits' sits over plain deletion notes ('“basically” was talk, not the point. The line says the same without it.') that don't explain a hit. (b) After two put-backs: 'You put back “I just think that”, “honestly”. Nothing else to cut.' is a comma list with no 'and'. (c) Pasting a brand-new line after a Sharpen shows 'Edited. Tap Sharpen again.' (d) 'reads like you’ve earned it' is vague.
issues.fix: (a) Label a cut-only result 'What changed' and keep 'Why it hits' for moves (beats, number first, asked/answered, said it straight). (b) Join the put-back words with the page's list() helper ('“I just think that” and “honestly”'). (c) Use 'Tap Sharpen to see yours.' when sameLine() is false and keep 'Edited…' for the same line. (d) Replace with 'Said plainly, “…” sounds sure of itself.'

issues.where: Pricing lede; final card #fp-note; trust .rules lock line; Try label; FAQ qa3
issues.problem: The pricing H2 'Sharpening is free. Forever.' is restated by the lede's 'Sharpen is free and unlimited, with Claude in the app.' The final sub 'Paste one in and watch it sharpen as you type.' is restated by the card note 'An example. Paste your own line and this turns into yours as you type.' The engine architecture (Claude in the app, on-device fallback, the demo stays in your browser) is explained four times. 'In plain words' appears as a heading, a Pro bullet and a legal sub. The founder asked for less text.
issues.fix: Lede: 'A rewrite is three fresh takes in your voice: 20 a month on Free, 250 on Pro, 500 per client on Studio.' Final note: 'An example. Yours replaces it as you type.' Trust lock line: 'Posts go out through X’s official API. This page’s demo never leaves your browser.' Keep the full engine explanation only in the FAQ. Pro bullet: 'Results: what landed, and what to write next'.

issues.problem: (a) The Pro yearly subtitle is three sentences ('$12 a month, billed yearly ($144). Or $16 month to month. Cancel anytime: a yearly plan runs to the end of the year you paid for.') in a sheet that should be one glance. (b) 'Open the working demo (it still wears the old look)' sounds apologetic and internal at the end of the funnel. (c) Any last Try or final line is carried in, even an untouched 'ok' or 'gm', so 'Your line: ok' shows on the nav's Start free and on Start with Pro from pricing.
issues.fix: (a) Sub: '$12 a month, billed yearly ($144). Cancel anytime.' Leave the run-to-end detail in the plans fine print. (b) Use 'Try the working demo' with the secondary line '(earlier design)'. (c) Set lastLine only when the result was sharpened or the visitor put a word back, and don't attach it to sheets opened from pricing.

issues.problem: A cost is shown with a benefit tick, so it reads like a fee in the feature list.
issues.fix: Make it 'Learns your voice from 8 posts (uses 5 rewrites, once)'.

issues.where: #trust .rules first line 'Plug replies and reruns of your best posts stay off until you switch them on.'
issues.problem: This is the only mention of these two features anywhere, including pricing. 'Reruns of your best posts' is the auto-repost automation the line above says 'isn’t here, on purpose', so the tile slightly contradicts itself. 'Plug replies' is jargon outside X power users.
issues.fix: Either cut the line (the tile is stronger with three Nevers and the API line), or make it 'Auto-plug replies and reposting old hits are off until you turn them on, post by post.' and add the two features to Pro's 'everything included' list.

issues.where: legal.html Terms 'Scores are a guide: The hook score is five checks on your words.'
issues.problem: 'Hook score' is never shown or named on the homepage, so a reader meets an unexplained product term in the terms.
issues.fix: Either rename it to what the homepage shows ('Sharpen’s marks are a guide: they’re checks on your words. They can’t promise reach, and they don’t try to.') or drop the item until the score appears on the site.
